prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Waiting screen info enhancements (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (+5.0%, +5.7%, +4.1%), though 4 tests showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens (new_screen) can be helpful, winning 2 tests (+15.4%, +6.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 3 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) can be helpful, winning 1 test (+7.0%), though 1 test showed no clear effect.
Reordering steps (reorder) hurt performance in 1 test (-3.8%) and showed no clear effect in another.
Copy changes, redesigns, hints, and notifications showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins (e.g., predicting +3.0% vs +15.4% measured, +0.0% vs +7.0% measured) and were too high for tests showing no clear effect or losses.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -0.5% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +2.5% over 5 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -2.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -3.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +0.2% over 2 test(s)
- finish, hint: +4.2% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +4.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +0.5% over 2 test(s)
- home, notification: -1.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.8% over 7 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +1.2% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.6% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, layout: +7.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:

- sign_in: 75.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Pet Desk Appearance Warmup Screen: Adds a dedicated transition screen right after waiting to signal that the desktop engine is launching the pet onto the screen. (why: Conversion drops significantly at the finish step (64.8%, mean time 5815s) and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on the desktop.)
1: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Display Verification Tip: Displays an explanatory tip on the waiting screen showing users how to check the system tray if their pet does not immediately appear. (why: 3 support emails reported the pet not showing up on the desktop or the app stalling, while wait_info enhancements previously yielded up to +5.7% wins.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Screen Split Feature Showcase Redesign: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a clear side-by-side split layout detailing preset vs custom photo creation paths. (why: Choose path screen has high mean duration (514s), indicating hesitation; layout improvements can increase decision speed and conversion.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Customization Photo Quality Preview Flow: Introduces an inline photo verification and live pet generation preview step on the upload_photos screen. (why: 3 support emails complained about custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect, which causes drop-off in the adoption step (74.8% conversion).)
4: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Two Column Companion Comparison: Changes the pick_friend layout to a side-by-side two-column view to compare starter pet traits. (why: Adoption stage takes a median of 89s and mean of 1017s; layout redesigns previously improved conversion by up to +7.0%.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Sign-In Existing Pet Data Preservation Notice: Updates headline and body on the sign-in screen to explicitly state that signing in saves existing pets and prevents resets. (why: Top support issue (8 emails) was pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
6: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Quick Command Overview Screen: Adds a post-onboarding guidance screen showing how to right-click, hide, control, and talk to the pet. (why: Support received 3 emails about post-onboarding confusion regarding pet controls, and finish completion rate is currently low at 64.8%.)
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Engine Status Indicator on Waiting Screen: Adds progress tracking indicators and time estimates for background engine rendering while users wait. (why: Home waiting stage has long wait times (median 201s, mean 2336s); clear progress status reduces drop-off during long wait times.)
8: [home, notification] Desktop Launch Ready Alert Trigger: Enables readiness notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet is ready to appear on desktop. (why: High mean wait time on home step (2336s) indicates users switch away while waiting; notification brings them back to finish.)
9: [finish, layout] Home Intro Spotlight Onboarding Complete View: Switches home_intro screen to a spotlight layout focusing on immediate desktop pet interaction. (why: Finish screen step conversion is only 64.8%; spotlighting completion creates a clear transition into active usage.)
